```yaml
name: Benchmark v2 (SWE-Lancer)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      exercise:
        description: 'Task ID (e.g., 16912_4)'
        required: true
      agent:
        description: 'Agent to use'
        required: false
        default: 'claude'
      provider:
        description: 'Provider to use'
        required: false
        default: 'anthropic'
      model:
        description: 'Model to use'
        required: false
        default: 'claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022'
      timeout_seconds:
        description: 'Timeout in seconds for the benchmark run'
        required: false
        default: '3600'
      v2_setup_wait_seconds:
        description: 'Wait time in seconds for v2 setup (TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC)'
        required: false
        default: '900'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}-v2
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  run-benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 360
    steps:
      - name: Disk cleanup
        run: |
          echo "Cleaning up disk space..."
          sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf "/usr/local/share/boost"
          sudo rm -rf "$AGENT_TOOLSDIRECTORY"
          sudo docker system prune -af
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/android
          sudo rm -rf /usr/local/lib/node_modules
          df -h

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          lfs: true
          submodules: recursive

      - name: Setup Bun
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v1
        with:
          bun-version: latest

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: bun install

      - name: Create patches directory
        run: mkdir -p .patches

      - name: Pull Docker image
        run: docker pull swelancer/swelancer_x86_monolith:releasev1

      - name: Run Benchmark v2
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT: ${{ secrets.AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT }}
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          MISTRAL_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.MISTRAL_API_KEY }}
          GROQ_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GROQ_API_KEY }}
          TOGETHER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TOGETHER_API_KEY }}
          TS_BENCH_V2_SETUP_WAIT_SEC: ${{ inputs.v2_setup_wait_seconds }}
          BENCH_EXERCISE: ${{ inputs.exercise }}
          BENCH_AGENT: ${{ inputs.agent }}
          BENCH_PROVIDER: ${{ inputs.provider }}
          BENCH_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          BENCH_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.timeout_seconds }}
        run: |
          bun src/index.ts \
            --dataset v2 \
            --docker \
            --exercise "$BENCH_EXERCISE" \
            --agent "$BENCH_AGENT" \
            --provider "$BENCH_PROVIDER" \
            --model "$BENCH_MODEL" \
            --timeout "$BENCH_TIMEOUT"

      - name: Upload results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: benchmark-v2-results-${{ inputs.exercise }}
          path: |
            data/results/
            results/
            logs/
            benchmark-summary.txt
            .patches/
          retention-days: 30
```
